ms.report:
Complete Proof of Achievement for Milestone 1: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oWu_bBzUkPqDJ3H8cuQt6LEHyU7wsjKVE8P9dlG8vNI/edit?usp=sharing
Regarding the User Experience > User can register, our team decided to establish an external form so the regional BD Team can review applicants before starting. Two main reasons, first to control a minimum quality for registration, avoiding spam accounts and secondly, an improved experience for interested participants who will receive from the start a tailored response and path within the platform. The flow will be: Form submission > BD Team Review > Email with Platform Access. Here is an example of this form: https://shorturl.at/ISF17

ms.promise:
Develop materials tailored specifically for technical founders new to the ecosystem. This includes guided tutorials, ecosystem overviews, and integration walkthroughs aimed at driving real adoption and code contributions. Both courses and newly created content will be professionally translated into Chinese, making it fully accessible to our initial target audience and ready for program rollout.
To ensure cultural and linguistic relevance, we actively engaged with the existing Chinese-speaking Cardano community, joining key social media groups, identifying trusted influencers, and tracking relevant events. This groundwork helped align content with actual user needs and ecosystem expectations.

ms.promise:
We'll collaborate with members of the Cardano community to identify channels and gather recommendations for high-potential applicants into the program. This coordination helped align our outreach with the ecosystem’s active contributors and trusted networks.
In parallel, we created a detailed messaging and targeting profile designed for Infrastructure’s founder-sourcing platform. This profile identifies developers showing clear 'build intent', measured through public repos, community engagement, and startup indicators, and proactively invites them into the program.
With open enrollment in place, we'll have the first two groups, the first five founders, and then ten founders, who will join the program. These initial groups provide an early opportunity to gather structured feedback through Net Promoter Score (NPS) surveys and track progress metrics, such as completion rates for each stage of the curriculum.
All relevant participation data is logged on the platform and available to milestone reviewers for transparent evaluation.
